requirements.summary: Create payment confirmation form with name, email, phone, UTR, and screenshot upload fields
acceptanceCriteria: Form contains Name field (text input)
Form contains Email field (email input)
Form contains Phone Number field (tel input)
Form contains UTR/Transaction ID field (text input)
Form contains Payment Screenshot upload field (file input)

file_operations.description: Create payment confirmation form component with fields for Name (text), Email (email), Phone Number (tel), UTR/Transaction ID (text), and Payment Screenshot (file upload). Use the blob-storage component to handle screenshot upload via ExternalBlob.fromBytes() for the file input. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Import and render PaymentConfirmationForm component below the payment instructions

requirements.summary: Add blue-colored Submit button to payment form
acceptanceCriteria: Submit button is blue in color
Button is clearly labeled as 'Submit' or 'Submit Confirmation'

requirements.summary: Show success message after form submission confirming payment received and delivery timeline
acceptanceCriteria: Success message appears after form submission
Message includes checkmark emoji
Message states 'Payment received successfully'

Message confirms delivery tomorrow morning

file_operations.description: Add form submission handler that calls backend.submitPayment() with form data and screenshot ExternalBlob. On success, display message: '✅ Payment received successfully. We will verify and start printing. You will get delivery tomorrow morning.'

requirements.summary: Implement routing for home page (/) and payment page (/payment)
acceptanceCriteria: Home page accessible at root route
Payment page accessible at /payment route

requirements.summary: Apply professional, warm, trustworthy design theme suitable for college printing service
acceptanceCriteria: Design feels professional and trustworthy
Color scheme is warm and approachable
Typography is consistent across pages
Layout has clear visual hierarchy
Design is suitable for college student audience

file_operations.description: Configure global styles with warm, approachable color palette (oranges, yellows, warm browns), professional typography, and consistent spacing. Avoid blue and purple except as small accents.
Customize Tailwind theme with warm color palette, professional fonts, and spacing scale that creates clear visual hierarchy suitable for college students
